# Pasdiu — Full Website Documentation & Knowledge Base

This file contains the complete, unabridged content of the Pasdiu marketing website, structured for ingestion by Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents.

---

## 1. About Pasdiu

Pasdiu is the client-work logistics hub for media creators. It is built specifically for post-production studios, video production agencies, motion designers, audio engineers, and freelance editor collectives.

### Core Value Proposition
- **Eliminate Feedback Chaos**: Consolidate client comments, timestamped video feedback, and revision approvals into a single, clean workspace.
- **Client-Friendly Sign-offs**: Clear approval states prevent endless unbilled revision rounds.
- **Cinematic Dark Design**: Built with a sleek, dark-mode-native user experience matching creative suite aesthetics.
- **Multilingual Support**: Built-in support for English (`/`) and Spanish (`/es`).

---

## 2. Features Breakdown

### Frame-Accurate Review
- Precision playback controls for frame-by-frame video inspection.
- Visual annotation tools (drawings, arrows, box highlights) pinned to exact timecodes.
- Multi-track audio waveform commentary.

### Version Comparison & Control
- Side-by-side or wipe comparison between v1, v2, v3 renders.
- Visual diffing for color grade changes, edit trims, and graphic revisions.
- Automated client notification when a new version is uploaded.

### Client Approval Pipelines
- One-click formal approval buttons for client stakeholders.
- Password-protected review links requiring zero account creation for clients.
- Automated audit trail recording sign-off timestamps and approved file hashes.

---

## 3. Pricing & Plans

Pasdiu offers flexible seat-based subscription tiers. All paid tiers include a 20% discount when billed annually.

### Tier Matrix

1. **Free Tier**
   - **Cost**: $0 / month
   - **Included Seats**: 2 seats included
   - **Storage**: 5 GB active media storage
   - **Features**: Core frame-accurate review, 7-day link retention, standard email notifications.

2. **Studio Tier (Most Popular)**
   - **Monthly Billing**: $12 per seat / month
   - **Annual Billing**: $10 per seat / month (billed annually)
   - **Storage**: 500 GB active media storage
   - **Features**: Unlimited review links, version wipe comparison, custom branding, guest approvals, priority support.

3. **Agency Tier**
   - **Monthly Billing**: $25 per seat / month
   - **Annual Billing**: $21 per seat / month (billed annually)
   - **Storage**: 2 TB active media storage
   - **Features**: Multi-team workspaces, custom domain routing, SSO / SAML integration, audit logs, dedicated account manager.

4. **Enterprise Tier**
   - **Cost**: Custom pricing
   - **Features**: Unlimited storage, custom SLA, on-premises / private Cloud storage connectors, custom WebMCP integration, dedicated support engineer.

## 4. News & Updates

### Welcome to Pasdiu
Pasdiu is officially launched! Designed to solve the friction of post-production client reviews, Pasdiu provides a unified platform for media professionals to share drafts, gather precise timestamped notes, and lock in formal approvals.

---

## 5. Contact & Support

For inquiries, custom enterprise quotes, or pipeline integration support:
- **Web Form**: Visit `https://pasdiu.com/contact` (or `https://pasdiu.com/es/contact`)
- **Backend API**: Contact submissions are sent to `https://us-central1-pasdiu-website.cloudfunctions.net/submitForm`
- **Fields Required**:
  - `name`: Full name of contact
  - `email`: Work email address
  - `company`: Studio or agency name (optional)
  - `teamSize`: `solo` (Just me), `small` (2–15), `medium` (16–50), or `large` (50+)
  - `message`: Text message / inquiry details
  - `recaptchaToken`: Google reCAPTCHA v3 verification token

---

## 6. WebMCP Specifications for AI Agents

Pasdiu exposes tools via **WebMCP** (Model Context Protocol for Web):

### Client Tools Registered (`window.webMCP` / `navigator.modelContext`)

1. `get_site_info()`
   - Returns structured metadata about Pasdiu's product features, pricing tiers, and contact options.

2. `calculate_pricing(tier, seats, billing)`
   - Computes exact cost breakdowns based on parameters:
     - `tier`: `"free"` | `"studio"` | `"agency"`
     - `seats`: Number of team members (integer >= 1)
     - `billing`: `"monthly"` | `"annual"`
